external_measure.source: Gmyrek et al. (2025), ILO Working Paper 140
external_measure.construct: automation potential of tasks under generative AI
external_measure.note: AIOE measures exposure to AI capability; the two constructs overlap but are not identical, so part of any gap is construct difference rather than transfer loss.

does_the_spread_predict_disagreement.verdict: No. Bundled codes agree with the independent measure at least as well as clean ones, and filtering on the within-code spread does not improve agreement. The spread reflects heterogeneity inside the occupational category, which any ISCO-level measure inherits, rather than error introduced by the crossing.
